run_broker_default: run a moolib broker listening on 0.0.0.0:4431 using the default address
run_broker_custom_address: run a moolib broker listening on a custom address like 127.0.0.1:5000
review_main: review the main function that creates an Rpc, sets its name, and starts a Broker loop
review_broker_loop: review the broker update loop that calls broker.update every 0.25 seconds until interrupted
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support configurable update intervals instead of hardcoded 0.25 seconds
